title: The Progression of Blood (3): the Akeda — one substitute covers one boy
summary: Third step in “The Progression of Blood”: the Akeda (Binding of Isaac), where one substitute sacrifice covers one boy. Genesis 22:13 is quoted, with the ram that Abraham offered in place of his son highlighted in red.

text.text: One Substitute Sacrifice Covers One Boy

13 Then Abraham raised his eyes and looked, and behold, behind him a ram caught in the thicket by his horns; and Abraham went and took the ram and offered him up for a burnt offering in the place of his son.

keywords: in the place of his son
in the stead of his son
